characters.summary: Princess Peach is the ruler of the Mushroom Kingdom who fights using magical abilities, parasols, sports equipment, and various item power-ups. Though frequently kidnapped, she has demonstrated substantial capability in combat, platforming, and sports spinoffs.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to being captured or ambushed when separated from guards
limitations: Magical emotional vibes drain her Vibe Gauge if used excessively

sources.supports: General overview of Princess Peach's history, abilities, and appearances in Super Mario games.
Detailed breakdown of abilities, items, and spin-off appearances such as Super Princess Peach.

feats.claim: Floated across wide gaps using a parasol.
Used emotional powers such as Joy, Gloom, Rage, and Calm to manipulate the environment and defeat enemies.

notableResults.note: Captured by Bowser at the start of the game.

campaignTags.claim: Uses emotional vibes and magical spells in Super Princess Peach.
Uses her parasol to slow her descent and glide across gaps.
Can heal herself using the Joy vibe in Super Princess Peach.

unknowns: Extent of her magical potential outside of specific spin-off titles remains inconsistent across standard platformers.

characters.summary: Elephant Peach is a transformed state of Princess Peach granting massive physical strength, increased size, and a powerful trunk swipe. She can smash through blocks and clear obstacles with overwhelming brute force.

mechanisms: Larger physical mass for blocking attacks

weaknesses: Reduced agility compared to base form
limitations: Transformation is temporary and dependent on retaining the Elephant power-up state
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Peach into an elephant, granting immense physical strength, a trunk swing attack, water absorption/spraying capabilities, and a larger physical frame at the cost of standard agility.

sources.supports: Elephant Peach abilities, trunk usage, and Super Mario Bros. Wonder mechanics.

feats.claim: Swung her trunk to clear out rows of enemies and break through solid block walls.

campaignTags.claim: Transforms into a large elephant form approximately doubling her normal height and bulk.
Can suck up water with her trunk and spray it out.

unknowns: Exact duration of the Elephant transformation without collecting additional items.

characters.summary: Radiant Peach is a mystical transformation unlocked by restoring the Sparkle Theater, granting her powerful glowing light attacks and enhanced magical energy projection to banish darkness.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to overwhelming corrupting darkness if light is snuffed out
limitations: Requires connection to the Sparkle Theater's magical energy
characters.formDifferences: Enhances Peach with glowing theatrical magic, granting ranged light-based projectile attacks and purification abilities.

sources.supports: Radiant Peach form details, Sparkle powers, and defeating Grape's minions.

feats.claim: Pushed back waves of Grape's theatrical minions using concentrated radiant light beams.

campaignTags.claim: Channels pure magical theater light to purify corrupted areas.
Floats and glides using radiant magical energy.

unknowns: Whether Radiant Peach's abilities function outside of theatrical realms.

characters.summary: Swordfighter Peach is a specialized combat transformation equipped with fencing blades, allowing her to execute rapid thrusts, parries, and acrobatic counter-attacks against armed adversaries.
weaknesses: Limited range against heavy ranged attackers
limitations: Strictly limited to close-quarters melee combat
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard abilities with expert fencing prowess, granting high-speed melee rapier attacks and defensive parries.

sources.supports: Swordfighter Peach combat moves, rapier usage, and boss fights in Princess Peach: Showtime!

feats.claim: Parried incoming sword strikes and defeated armored guards in single combat.

campaignTags.claim: Equipped with specialized theatrical fencing rapiers.

unknowns: Durability of the magical rapier against extremely heavy armor.

weaknesses: Advanced age limits physical combat capability
limitations: Relies entirely on external Pokémon for offensive and defensive combat actions

characters.summary: Pyramid Head is a manifestation of guilt and punishment from Silent Hill 2. He is an immensely durable executioner wielding a massive Great Knife and spear, operating with unstoppable, relentless melee menace.
weaknesses: Extreme slowness and lack of ranged attack options
limitations: Movement speed is consistently slow and deliberate

sources.supports: Overview of Pyramid Head, symbolism, and role in Silent Hill 2.
Detailed combat behavior, weapons (Great Knife and Spear), and feats.

feats.claim: Dragged a massive Great Knife effortlessly and killed monsters and humans with single execution strikes.
Impaled monsters through metal bars with a long spear.

notableResults.note: Engaged James multiple times before committing suicide when his purpose was fulfilled.

unknowns: True biological nature beyond being a supernatural manifestation of James's psyche.

weaknesses: Dies instantly upon falling off the edge of a platform without a disc
limitations: Cannot attack opponents directly without items or environmental hazards

characters.summary: Raiden is a master cyborg ninja equipped with high-frequency blades, superhuman agility, and advanced cybernetic enhancements. He excels at ultra-fast close-quarters combat, blade mode slicing, and deflecting heavy ordnance.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to intense electromagnetic pulses (EMP) or massive structural damage exceeding cybernetic limits
limitations: Requires periodic electrolyte extraction to sustain self-repair and peak combat output

weaknesses: Can be weakened or stripped of power when separated from Earthrealm or trapped in anti-divine realms
limitations: Restricted by Elder God decrees regarding direct intervention in mortal conflicts
